## Setup - Run in console
#install.packages(c("here", "remotes", "birdie", "haven", "foreign"))
#remotes::install_github("CoryMcCartan/birdie")

```{r setup_birdie, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries (make sure to install these first manually in the Console)
options(timeout = 600)
repos <- c(CRAN = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/latest")
# Find project root by walking up until we find the Data directory
.dir <- getwd()
while (!dir.exists(file.path(.dir, "Data")) && .dir != dirname(.dir)) {
  .dir <- dirname(.dir)
}
parent_dir <- .dir
install.packages("remotes", repos = repos)
remotes::install_version("haven", version = "2.5.4", repos = repos, type = "source", upgrade = "never")
if (!requireNamespace("foreign", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("foreign", repos = repos)
remotes::install_version("birdie", version = "0.6.1", repos = repos, type = "source", upgrade = "never")
remotes::install_version("dplyr", version = "1.1.4", repos = repos, type = "source", upgrade = "never")
remotes::install_version("remotes", version = "2.5.0", repos = repos, type = "source", upgrade = "never")
library(birdie)
```



```{r birdie_predict, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load voter data using relative path (recommended)
datazip <- haven::read_dta(file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "PPP_birdie_interim.dta"))

datazip$surnameUPPER <- toupper(datazip$surname)
datazip$zipcode_fct <- as.factor(datazip$zipcode)
datazip$surname_fct <- as.factor(datazip$surnameUPPER)
datazip$fintech_fct <- as.factor(datazip$fintech_reg)

r_probs <- birdie::bisg(~ nm(surname_fct) + zip(zipcode_fct), data = datazip)

fit <- birdie::birdie(r_probs, fintech_fct ~ proc_zip(zipcode_fct), data = datazip)

# Extract matrix
mat <- fit$map

# Optional: set names if not already present
if (nrow(mat) == 2) {
  dimnames(mat) <- list(c("nonfintech", "fintech"), colnames(mat))
}

# Now compute gaps for fintech group
black_white     <- mat["fintech", "black"] - mat["fintech", "white"]
black_hisp      <- mat["fintech", "black"] - mat["fintech", "hisp"]
black_asian     <- mat["fintech", "black"] - mat["fintech", "asian"]
hisp_white      <- mat["fintech", "hisp"]  - mat["fintech", "white"]
hisp_asian      <- mat["fintech", "hisp"]  - mat["fintech", "asian"]
asian_white     <- mat["fintech", "asian"] - mat["fintech", "white"]

# Print all results
gaps <- c(
  "Black - White"     = black_white,
  "Black - Hispanic"  = black_hisp,
  "Black - Asian"     = black_asian,
  "Hispanic - White"  = hisp_white,
  "Hispanic - Asian"  = hisp_asian,
  "Asian - White"     = asian_white
)

print(round(gaps, 3))

gap_df <- data.frame(
  gap_name = c("black_white",
               "black_hispanic",
               "black_asian",
               "hispanic_white",
               "hispanic_asian",
               "asian_white"),
  estimate = c(black_white,
               black_hisp,
               black_asian,
               hisp_white,
               hisp_asian,
               asian_white)
)

haven::write_dta(gap_df, file.path(parent_dir, "Data", "PPP_birdie_prediction.dta"))



```
